title: 第一卷 第25章 叶云 我看你像我孙子第一卷 第26章 这不就来活了吗
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
眼看两边针锋相对，白衣老者只得站出来调和一下。
“两位都冷静点，咱们聚在这里，乃是为了三圣试炼，而非为了互相争斗，你们说是吧？”
有了他递出来的台阶，鹤发童子也没再继续与火仙儿争论。
“也是，这个话题到此为止。”
鹤发童子轻哼一声，旋即对身边的黑衣青年冷声道。
“如今看来，古道圣地这次气势很盛，记得试炼开始后，遇到他们的弟子上点心。”
那黑衣青年外表极为张扬，明明有储物袋，但腰间还是别了一把长刀。
叶云打量了他一眼，能清晰的感受到，对方并未遮掩气息，简直在身上写了凝气巅峰这四个字。
“这家伙，还真是装逼啊……”
面对鹤发童子的话，这黑衣青年阴森森地回了一句。
“前辈放心，弟子定然好好照顾古道圣地的弟子，”
这一问一答，简直就是明晃晃的威胁。
火仙儿不为所动，淡淡回道。
“那就看你，有没有这个实力了。”
黑衣青年也是够嚣张，面对火仙儿的话都轻笑一声。
“好，那前辈就看着吧。”
接着似是注意到叶云的目光，转眼冷冷看了他一眼。
“老东西，盯着我看什么看？想死吗？”
看他这逮人就怼的样子，估计就是路过的狗，都得被他踹上一脚。

叶云可没惯着他，白了他一眼道。
“没啥，就是看你像我孙子。”
“老东西，你找死！”
黑衣青年杀气腾腾，眼看又要针尖对麦芒。
见状，白衣老者又出来打圆场。
“行了行了，别说废话，都准备开门吧。”
正如白衣老者所说，他们聚在这里，重点还是三圣试炼。
黑衣青年轻哼一声，眼神恶狠狠的瞪了眼叶云，似乎在说你等着吧！
至于叶云则懒得理他，视线看向在他们不远处的一座巨大石门。
“看来三圣试炼，就在这里面进行……”
按照广泛的说法，这三圣试炼所在空间，乃是三大圣地共同封印，故而要解封进入也需要三方的配合。
果不其然，在他的注视下，火仙儿，鹤发童子，乃至白衣老者，他们围绕着巨大石门三角形站定。
他们手中分别取出一块玉牌，随着各自玄气的注入，三道颜色各异的光束注入石门。
随着彩色的光芒在石门中绽放，这巨大的石门，竟是化作如同传送门一样，强烈的吸引力从中不断传出！
“大门已开，都准备进去吧。”
白衣老者望着众人，朗声交代道。
“在试炼空间内，将会存在多个传送门，并在十天之后开启，并持续一刻钟的时间。”
“你们切记，要在这个时间之内通过传送门，回到这里。”
闻言，叶云不由问了一句。
“那要是没来得及呢？”

鹤发童子冷笑一声，替他做出了回答。
“没赶上？那就准备在里面呆无数年，全家开席吧。”
这时，红仙儿瞥了他一眼，对叶云等人淡淡道。
“都不必紧张，传送门位置明显，开启前也将有提示，你们稍加留意即可。”
“是！”

Seeing the tit-for-tat confrontation between the two sides, the old man in white had no choice but to step forward to mediate.
"Both of you, calm down. We are gathered here for the Trial of the Three Saints, not to fight each other, don't you think so?"
With the steps he handed over, the crane-haired boy stopped arguing with Huo Xian'er.
"Yes, this topic ends here."
The crane-haired boy snorted, and then said coldly to the young man in black next to him.
"Now it seems that the Ancient Holy Land is very powerful this time. Remember to give snacks to their disciples when you meet them after the trial begins."
The young man in black had a very flamboyant appearance. He obviously had a storage bag, but he still had a long knife on his waist.
Ye Yun took a look at him and could clearly feel that the other person did not conceal his aura, and simply had the words "Qi Condensation Peak" written on his body.
"This guy is really showing off..."
Facing the words of the white-haired boy, the young man in black replied sinisterly.
"Senior, don't worry, I will definitely take good care of the disciples in the Ancient Holy Land,"
This question and answer is simply a clear threat.
Huo Xian'er was unmoved and replied calmly.
"Then it depends on whether you have the strength."
The young man in black was also arrogant enough, and he chuckled lightly when faced with Huo Xian'er's words.
"Okay, senior, just watch."
Then he seemed to notice Ye Yun's gaze and glanced at him coldly.
"Old man, why are you staring at me? Do you want to die?"
Judging from the way he was attacking anyone he caught, he would probably kick any dog that was passing by.
Ye Yun was not used to him and rolled his eyes at him.
"Nothing, I just think you look like my grandson."
"Old guy, you're looking for death!"
The young man in black was full of murderous intent, and he was about to confront the enemy again.
Seeing this, the old man in white came out again to smooth things over.
"Okay, okay, don't talk nonsense, get ready to open the door."
As the old man in white said, when they gather here, the focus is still on the Trial of the Three Saints.
The young man in black snorted and glared at Ye Yun fiercely, as if to say, just wait!
As for Ye Yun, he was too lazy to pay attention to him and looked at a huge stone gate not far from them.
"It seems that the Trial of the Three Saints is taking place here..."
According to a general theory, the space where the Three Saints Trial is located is jointly sealed by the three holy places, so unsealing and entering requires the cooperation of the three parties.
Sure enough, under his gaze, the fire fairy, the white-haired boy, and even the old man in white stood around the triangle of the huge stone door.
They each took out a jade tablet in their hands, and with the injection of their own profound energy, three beams of different colors were injected into the stone door.
As the colorful light bloomed in the stone door, this huge stone door turned into a portal, and strong attraction continued to spread from it!
"The door is open, get ready to go in."
The old man in white looked at everyone and explained in a loud voice.
"In the trial space, there will be multiple portals, which will open in ten days and last for a quarter of an hour."
"You must remember to pass through the portal and return here within this time."
Hearing this, Ye Yun couldn't help but ask.
"What if there's no time?"
The crane-haired boy sneered and answered for him.
"Can't make it? Then prepare to stay there for countless years and have a feast with the whole family."
At this time, Hong Xian'er glanced at him and said calmly to Ye Yun and others.
"Don't be nervous. The location of the portal is obvious, and there will be a prompt before it is opened. Just pay attention."
"Yes!"
